meta.data_note: Synthetic OHLCV demo data -- not real BTC history.

model_descriptions.buy_and_hold: Always predicts a small fixed positive return -- the 'stay long' baseline.
model_descriptions.naive_zero: Always predicts zero return -- the efficient-market / random-walk baseline.
model_descriptions.auto_arima: Classical autoregressive model fit on the return series alone, no other features.
model_descriptions.ridge: Linear regression with L2 regularization over the full engineered feature set.
model_descriptions.random_forest: An ensemble of decision trees, each voting on a bootstrapped subset of history.
model_descriptions.xgboost: Gradient-boosted decision trees that iteratively correct the previous trees' errors.
model_descriptions.lstm: A recurrent neural network that reads the last 30 days of features as a sequence.
model_descriptions.transformer: A self-attention encoder that weighs all 30 days in its input window jointly.
